XenotypeDef.label: gen 1 synth
XenotypeDef.description: The Institute's first synthetic humanoid. Servos and struts under exposed plating, built for labor and retrieval, and never meant to pass for anything but a machine.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An early Institute android, plainly mechanical.

XenotypeDef.label: gen 2 synth
XenotypeDef.description: A later Institute line grown with synthetic muscle and skin over a metal frame. Close enough to human to walk the surface unnoticed, close enough to keep its orders without question.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An Institute android built to pass for human at a glance.
